description.value: Pedal Bros. is BC's only specialty recumbent trike sales and service shop, re-opened in downtown Kamloops in 2023 after earlier roots in Chase, BC. The shop deals in TerraTrike and Trident Trike recumbent trikes, including e-trike models, alongside accessories from Bivo, Sena, and Portland Design Works. A touring cyclist will find a knowledgeable, cycling-passionate team in a central Kamloops location, though the shop's expertise and service are focused on three-wheeled recumbent cycles rather than standard touring bikes.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (1 space) at 47m; rack (1 space) at 54m; rack (7 spaces) at 94m. Total: 9 spaces.
